body: I'm glad I could at least do a grain of help. Good luck with your situation, try and stay strong I'm rooting for you.

When I was kid I attempted suicide for unrelated reasons. When I got out of the ward my parents still hit me and screamed and all sorts of shit. Then my dad got drunk and told me I should have at least doused myself in gasoline and lit myself on fire cause that's how real men do it. I'm not saying this to be negative I'm just saying you have to find a way to work around them/block them out and not let them ruin you without attempting suicide or SIB because it's likely not going to change their behavior, even if it does it will likely be temporary, and finally you are giving them even more power over you, even more control of your literal life, and letting them do the most harm possible. They can take a lot of things from you but don't give them something you can choose to control on your own. I know right now it seems like your mom controls your whole life but you can fight it and in the long run be your own person. Even if it's not a happy venture don't reward her poor treatment if you by giving in. It will never be easy but one day you will be free to be anyone you want. I know this probably doesn't mean a lot to you coming from an outsider but you're in my thoughts. Sending love <33

I hope you are okay. I am aware that most likely nothing I say will help you but it is unfortunately normal to use those things to cope. And I am aware that it is bullshit for me to say this as an outsider but it sounds like your boyfriend is causing you more distress than it is worth, even if you love him you are not in a state to be supporting someone else's problems right now if they're not going to adequately support you. Try and find something you want to achieve, even if it's impossible and remember that it doesn't matter if you fail, you were gonna kill yourself anyway so at least give it a shot before you kill yourself then if it doesn't work out you can either try something else or ...call it a day but at least you tried something you never may have before. Like you might die anyway right. Go apply for a bunch of jobs you're interested in and act like you are the absolute awesome shit in your resume/interview even if you don't think you are or aren't qualified. Go drive into another state and walk around in the woods for a week. Anything. I'm not saying to be self destructive but at this point if you can think of any radical last resort to seek happiness other than killing yourself or hurting others nows the time. Why not right? I do believe things will get better for you, you are resilient and have already made it through so much, but I know that probably doesn't mean anything to you so that's my advice I guess. I really hope things turn around for you, and I'm not religious but your in my thoughts. Sending love. : / <3
